statement: The United States and Iran both publicly confirm a concluded agreement governing commercial transit of the Strait of Hormuz between 2026-08-06 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if official US and Iranian government statements confirming a concluded Hormuz transit agreement are issued in the window and reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: By window close no concluded agreement has been confirmed by both governments; talks ongoing, stalled, or collapsed all grade MISS.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A Russian missile or drone strike on Kyiv city kills at least 5 people in a single attack between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-31, per Ukrainian official casualty statements.
resolution: TRUE if Ukrainian authorities state at least 5 killed in one strike on Kyiv city within the window, reported by at least two international news outlets; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No single strike on Kyiv city within the window carries an official Ukrainian death toll of 5 or more.
